name: io.github.orchidautomation/outbound-sdk
title: outbound-sdk
description: Read-only MCP server: Instantly, Smartlead, HeyReach and EmailBison campaigns, leads and replies.

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOUND_SDK_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: instantly, smartlead, heyreach, emailbison, memory, or all (the default): every provider whose key is set.

environmentVariables.name: INSTANTLY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Instantly API V2 key. The all:read scope is enough.

environmentVariables.name: INSTANTLY_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: A label for this Instantly client or workspace.

environmentVariables.name: SMARTLEAD_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: A label for this Smartlead client or workspace.

environmentVariables.name: HEYREACH_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: A label for this HeyReach client or workspace.

environmentVariables.name: EMAILBISON_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EmailBison API key (an api-user key is scoped to one workspace).

environmentVariables.name: EMAILBISON_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The URL you log in to EmailBison with. Defaults to https://dedi.emailbison.com.

environmentVariables.name: EMAILBISON_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: A label for this EmailBison client or workspace.

environmentVariables.name: OUTBOUND_REDACT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Keeps masked tokens stable across sessions. A secret of at least 32 characters.
